demos.title: Cool and Detect
demos.subtitle: Doppler cool, spin-polarise, look twice
demos.note: The simplest thing the trap does, and the backbone of every other sequence: 1 ms of 397 at -25 MHz, a 20 us sigma pulse, then two 200 us detection windows at -10 MHz.

demos.title: 729 Carrier Sweep
demos.subtitle: Bare frequency, 15 kHz across the line
demos.note: A 500 us probe at 0.8 percent amplitude, stepped in 300 Hz increments across the S(-1/2) to D(-5/2) line: 15 kHz end to end, and nothing else on the 729 all run. Far too narrow and too weak for the standard mapping, so this run carries its own -- 1600 semitones per MHz opens the scan out over two octaves, and a steep amplitude response lifts the probe up next to the cooling light.

demos.title: GKP QEC, one mode
demos.subtitle: Error-correction rounds, 1 to 81
demos.note: The QEC block is a LoopSequence whose iteration count is the scanned parameter, so the correction cycle repeats more and more times before readout. That is the lifetime measurement. The run was measured at 1 to 81 rounds; the round count is a live parameter here, built from the one-round template.

demos.title: GKP QEC, two modes
demos.subtitle: Super Gate, both radial modes
demos.note: Same idea on both radial modes at once (2.543 and 2.805 MHz). Sideband cooling alternates between them, and the SDF pulses carry a two-tone structure around the carrier. Measured at 1 to 8 rounds; the round count is live.

demos.title: All sidebands, one ion
demos.subtitle: 81-point walk across the motional spectrum
demos.note: Standing in for motional coherence until that data is here: the 729 probe sweeps across carrier and motional sidebands, so the spectrum arrives as a melody.
